name: Qoo Caloa
source:
Qoo is a foreign girl who came to study at Kimisaki High around the same time as the [url=/c98200]Protagonist[/url]. Qoo loves sweets, so she often visits the cooking club to get some; she also practices making sweets on days when she doesn't have any lacrosse practice or competitions. [url=/c98228]Chiaki[/url] tends to be the one who cleans up her messes, while Qoo poses [url=/c98385]Hayate[/url] as her rival and often challenges her.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
